description: Unpublish a library entry immediately, without confirmation: the entry and all its versions are removed from the library. Plugins already added from it are kept. Allowed for those who may manage the entry. `entry` is the entry's exact name (matched case-insensitively, surrounding spaces ignored), or its id with `byId: true`; a value that looks like an id is still taken as a name without `byId`.

byId.description: `entry` is an entry id, not a name (CLI: --by-id).

entry.description: Library entry name, or its id with byId.

name: library_unpublish
title: Unpublish library entry
